userCompletionSentence: UI를 닫아도 실행은 계속되고, sleep·재부팅 뒤에는 중단 사실과 정확한 상태를 복원해 안전하게 재개한다.
positiveControls: local console server remains healthy when an HTTP UI client disconnects
Work, Automation, Telegram, collector, process wake and restart recovery already have independent canonical state
Telegram polling and result publication already use cross-process owner fencing

adoptedReferencePrinciples.principle: A headless gateway is owned by launchd or systemd and UI clients attach without owning its lifecycle.
A service manager owns restart after update and update flow preserves a recoverable pre-update state.

notAdopted: multiple user-configured agent profiles as the default product model
VPS, relay or remote runtime as an Alpha1 completion dependency
OS-specific service commands inside the product core
a second Work, Automation, Channel or collector state store

incidents.counterexample: Closing or crashing every UI client must not terminate or duplicate the single local runtime.
Closing a window and explicitly choosing T5 fully off must remain different user actions.
Two launch attempts must not create two Automation schedulers, Telegram pollers, collectors or result publishers.
An update between admission and effect settlement must not lose input or replay an external effect.
A crash before dispatch must remain not executed and allow exact safe resume.
A crash after dispatch but before acknowledgement must become unknown and must not blind retry.
Sleep time must not be recorded as active execution and wake must reconcile overdue work from canonical time.
Reboot must restore pending, interrupted and unknown as different states without invented success.
A locked-screen notification must not include user content, file names, counterparties, amounts or secrets by default.
Provider or channel outage must preserve local work and must not claim remote completion.
The core lifecycle contract must not encode launchd, systemd, Task Scheduler, POSIX signals or Windows handles as product meaning.
Resident Runtime must reuse current canonical stores instead of copying Work, Automation, Channel or collector truth into a daemon database.
